annotations.identity: Flat, wet marsh: pools, reeds and mud under a low sky; smoke from burned nests. Two lizardfolk peoples: the friendly Reedtalkers on their stilted village, and the Blackscales, raiders, to the east.
annotations.poi: Survivors' Camp; Reedtalker Village; Elder's Hut; Fishing Platforms; Burned Nests; Frog Nests; The Deep Pool; Croc's Wallow; Flooded Cave Mouth (to the Gnawdeep); War-Totems; Captive Pens; Blackscale Village; War-Shaman's Hut.

name: Brackwater Mire

annotations.intent: The Blackscales: Brackwater's hostile lizardfolk tribe, who've thrown in with the goblins. Their tokens are darkened from the lizardfolk sets so they read apart from the friendly Reedtalkers (green, NCUs). The hunter is their ranged threat; it pairs with a warrior.

blackscale-hunter.description: Throws barbed javelins from the reeds, then backs off to throw again.
blackscale-hunter.name: Blackscale Hunter

powers.description: A barbed javelin that hooks in and slows.
powers.name: Barbed Javelin

annotations.intent: The Blackscales: Brackwater's hostile lizardfolk tribe, who've thrown in with the goblins. Their tokens are darkened from the lizardfolk sets so they read apart from the friendly Reedtalkers (green, NCUs). The shaman heals; kill it first. Always with a warrior or hunter.

blackscale-shaman.description: A bone-masked shaman who knits its kin's wounds and curses their foes with rot.
blackscale-shaman.name: Blackscale Shaman

powers.description: Draws on the swamp to close a kinsman's wounds.
powers.name: Mire Mending

powers.description: A curse that rots the target from the inside.
powers.name: Bog Rot

annotations.balance: A quest boss, tuned by hand: 1.5x a solo's HP (450). Below half health it enrages (Swamp Fury) and starts Bog Wave, so a player should save cooldowns for the second phase.
annotations.intent: The Blackscales: Brackwater's hostile lizardfolk tribe, who've thrown in with the goblins. Their tokens are darkened from the lizardfolk sets so they read apart from the friendly Reedtalkers (green, NCUs). Their war-leader and L2's boss, in its lair deep in the mire, guarded by warriors and a shaman.

blackscale-war-shaman.description: The Blackscales' war-leader: a shaman who calls the swamp's fury down on anyone in the way.
blackscale-war-shaman.name: Blackscale War-Shaman

powers.description: A curse that rots the target from the inside.
powers.name: Bog Rot

powers.description: Rattles a bone totem; its warriors fight harder.
powers.name: War Totem

powers.description: Wounded, it calls the swamp's fury into itself.
powers.name: Swamp Fury

powers.description: The ground heaves with black water around it.
powers.name: Bog Wave

annotations.intent: The Blackscales: Brackwater's hostile lizardfolk tribe, who've thrown in with the goblins. Their tokens are darkened from the lizardfolk sets so they read apart from the friendly Reedtalkers (green, NCUs). The warrior is the front line: in pairs, or with a hunter or shaman.

blackscale-warrior.description: A dark-scaled lizardfolk with a bone club and a hide shield.
blackscale-warrior.name: Blackscale Warrior

powers.description: A heavy overhand blow that rattles the target.
powers.name: Club Smash

powers.description: Raises its shield and sets its feet.
powers.name: Hide Shield

annotations.intent: Brackwater Mire's common hostile beast, in groups of three on the pools' edges; the frog nests (S7).

giant-frog.description: A frog the size of a pony, with a tongue like a wet rope.
giant-frog.name: Giant Frog

powers.description: Lashes out with its sticky tongue, gumming up the target's legs.
powers.name: Tongue Lash

powers.description: Leaps and lands with a splash on everyone nearby.
powers.name: Bellyflop

annotations.balance: A named quest boss, tuned by hand: 1.5x the swamp crocodile's HP (900), with a second phase below half health.
annotations.intent: S9's named mob, in the croc's wallow in Brackwater Mire: the swamp crocodile that's been eating Reedtalker fishers. Lurks stealthed like the stock crocodile.

old-croc.description: A crocodile older than the Reedtalkers' oldest stories, scarred grey and as long as a boat.
old-croc.name: The Old Croc

powers.description: Clamps on and rolls, tearing the wound open.
powers.name: Death Roll

powers.description: Wounded, it thrashes its tail through the water around it.
powers.name: Thrash

annotations.intent: Lurks stealthed in Brackwater's open water and channels: a slow, tough solo that ambushes waders. The Old Croc (S9) is a named variant of this type.

swamp-crocodile.description: Lies under the scum, as still as a log, until something wades too close.
swamp-crocodile.name: Swamp Crocodile

powers.description: Clamps on and rolls, tearing the wound open.
powers.name: Death Roll

annotations.intent: Brackwater Mire's reed beds and causeways, in pairs. Stands in for the plan's leech swarm: neither token pack has leech art.

swamp-viper.description: A mottled green viper, hard to see in the reeds until it strikes.
swamp-viper.name: Swamp Viper

powers.description: A fast strike that leaves venom in the wound.
powers.name: Venomous Bite
